title.en: The buyer’s check on this page is what infrastructure window does LZ-60 print
title.zh: 本页要核对的是：LZ-60 给基建印了哪一扇窗口

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A diesel pipeline inside 100 m conveying and 300 m delivery height, with stone at 4 cm and below. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 for sites without stable grid power and for rural and infrastructure placement: 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. Taken from the printed row: It is not the Diesel 60 table that shares the code string.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。一段柴油管路，输送在 100 m 内、输送高度在 300 m 内，石子在 4 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 列为电网不稳以及农村与基建浇筑：145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。它不是共用代号字符串的那张柴油60表。

h1.zh: 本页要核对的是：LZ-60 给基建印了哪一扇窗口

Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 for sites without stable grid power and for rural and infrastructure placement: 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. Taken from the printed row: It is not the Diesel 60 table that shares the code string.
directAnswer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。一段柴油管路，输送在 100 m 内、输送高度在 300 m 内，石子在 4 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 列为电网不稳以及农村与基建浇筑：145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。它不是共用代号字符串的那张柴油60表。

body.en: “Fuel Consumption Converter” breaks its subject at “Fuel Consumption Unit Converter”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, delivery height 300 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. Keep this cell as published. It is not the Diesel 60 table that shares the code string. Taken from the printed row: Same output figure, different power and different distance. Read it in the Xingtai table. A 900 m horizontal line is Electric 80 and needs grid power. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Keep this cell as published. No. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. The scenario text includes rural and infrastructure placement, but the mass is 5500 kg. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fuel-consumption-converter-d_850.html
body.zh: 《Fuel Consumption Converter》在“燃油消耗单位”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。LZ-60 印了 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。这一格照已印出的读：更高排量的更长垂直列出在柴油120（150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h）。粗于 4 cm、直到 6 cm，是 LZ-80 或柴油120。水平 900 m 是电动80，并且要电网。LZ-60 不会伸到那些格子。目录里已经写着：不是。输送距离是 100 m。输送高度是 300 m。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fuel-consumption-converter-d_850.html

body.en: Borrow “Fuel Consumption Chart” from “Fuel Consumption Converter” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. A diesel pipeline inside 100 m conveying and 300 m delivery height, with stone at 4 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. HBT80-16 also prints 50 m³/h, but it is an electric building pump at 110 kW, 120 m horizontal and 360 m delivery height. Keep this cell as published. Longer vertical listing at high output is Diesel 120 (150 m / 500 m, 100 m³/h). Taken from the printed row: LZ-60 does not stretch to those cells. Read it in the Xingtai table. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Conveying distance is 100 m. Keep this cell as published. That split is on LZ-80. Taken from the printed row: The compact rural diesel is 800 kg.
body.zh: 把《Fuel Consumption Converter》的“燃油消耗图”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：一段柴油管路，输送在 100 m 内、输送高度在 300 m 内，石子在 4 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 列为电网不稳以及农村与基建浇筑：145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。它不是共用代号字符串的那张柴油60表。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请带上页面地址，避免把 HBT60-13.132 读成柴油60的 35 m³/h。这一格照已印出的读：没有。那种拆分在 LZ-80 上。LZ-60 印的是一个输送量和一个压力：50 m³/h 和 35 MPa。

body.en: The reference page “Fuel Consumption Converter” uses “Fuel Consumption Charts” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 for sites without stable grid power and for rural and infrastructure placement: 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. LZ-60 is the diesel infrastructure row at 145 kW and 100 m conveying. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Coarser than 4 cm, up to 6 cm, is LZ-80 or Diesel 120. Keep this cell as published. Include the URL so HBT60-13.132 is not read as Diesel 60’s 35 m³/h. Taken from the printed row: Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Read it in the Xingtai table. Delivery height is 300 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-60 prints one output and one pressure: 50 m³/h and 35 MPa. Keep this cell as published. Do not treat them as the same machine. Headings already printed: 50 m³/h here is not HBT80-16
body.zh: 来源页《Fuel Consumption Converter》用“燃油消耗图”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：HBT80-16 也印了 50 m³/h，但它是电动建筑泵：110 kW、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m。LZ-60 是柴油基建行：145 kW、输送 100 m。输送量数字相同，动力和距离不同。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。工况文字包含农村与基建浇筑，但质量是 5500 kg。紧凑的农村柴油泵是 800 kg。不要当成同一台机器。已印出的标题：这里的 50 m³/h 不是 HBT80-16

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Fuel Consumption Unit Converter” — Is 300 m the conveying distance?
question.zh: “燃油消耗单位”旁边仍要印着的是什么：300 m 是输送距离吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Conveying distance is 100 m. Delivery height is 300 m.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。输送距离是 100 m。输送高度是 300 m。

question.en: “Fuel Consumption Chart” does not change the check: Does LZ-60 print a dual pressure mode?
question.zh: “燃油消耗图”不改这一问：LZ-60 印了双压力模式吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. That split is on LZ-80. LZ-60 prints one output and one pressure: 50 m³/h and 35 MPa.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。那种拆分在 LZ-80 上。LZ-60 印的是一个输送量和一个压力：50 m³/h 和 35 MPa。

question.en: Is 5500 kg the rural pump, once the outline says “Fuel Consumption Charts”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“燃油消耗图”时，5500 kg 是农村泵吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The scenario text includes rural and infrastructure placement, but the mass is 5500 kg. The compact rural diesel is 800 kg. Do not treat them as the same machine.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：工况文字包含农村与基建浇筑，但质量是 5500 kg。紧凑的农村柴油泵是 800 kg。不要当成同一台机器。
